messages.message: Tangents are not used because the material has no normal texture.

views.front: The steel case reads as a smooth satin housing around the retained layered dial; the false coarse checker grain is gone.
views.rear: Compared with the prior full-size rear render, the hemispherical case now has continuous reflections instead of golf-ball-like repeating bumps.
views.detail: The full-size view retains the dial lettering, hour markers, hands and date window while restoring smooth original steel; small inherited bezel facets remain acceptable at application scale.
views.underside: The lower view preserves the distinct bezel and readable dial against the continuous steel hemisphere, without added grain or changed colors.
views.clay: The clay view confirms the original case geometry and layered clock mechanism remain intact; this correction restores the authored surface rather than claiming new geometric detail.
